title: Tunguska event blamed on the fire god Agdy

tellings.quote: So they believed that the event was caused by their god of fire [snorts] agi coming down from heaven to punish them.

plain: In 1908 a huge blast flattened forest in the Tunguska region of Siberia, and the local people are said to have believed it "was caused by their god of fire," Agdy, "coming down from heaven to punish them." The researcher Randall Carlson, who studies ancient catastrophes, tells Michels this without naming a source. He uses it to show how a people with no science of meteors would turn a blast from the sky into a story about an angry god.
